background.value: Photos must be taken on a white background

glasses_policy.value: Applicant must not wear glasses of any kind, except prescription eyewear

file_spec.value: Two (02) recent identity photos required; applicant's first and last names must be written in pencil on the back of each photo; the visa application form/photos cannot be submitted electronically — must be brought in person or sent by post to the Algerian embassy/consulate

glasses.en: The applicant must not wear glasses of any kind, except prescription eyewear.
glasses.ko: 안경 착용 불가. 단, 시력 교정용 도수 안경은 예외로 허용.
glasses.ja: 眼鏡の着用は不可。ただし度付き(視力矯正用)眼鏡は例外として許可。

direct_fetch_note.note: Direct WebFetch to www.mfa.gov.dz and multiple embassy subdomains (embwashington.mfa.gov.dz, cglondon.mfa.gov.dz) all failed with a TLS chain-validation error, consistent with a systemic fetch-tool issue on this domain family rather than a content problem. Values confirmed via grounded web search quoting the official 'Entry visa to Algeria' page, which is mirrored near-identically across multiple Algerian embassy subdomains (Washington, New Delhi, Amman, Abu Dhabi, Pretoria, Ankara, Oslo).

size.note: A '35×45mm' figure for the ENTRY visa specifically (as opposed to the passport) was seen only on third-party photo-vendor sites (photogov.net, visafoto.com, visapics.org) in the search results, not verbatim on any mfa.gov.dz page found. Since the passport-specific page does confirm 35×45mm for dz-passport, it is plausible the visa uses the same national photo standard, but this was not explicitly restated on the entry-visa page itself, so size is left unverified here rather than inferred.
